dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Hello there. Welcome to Yae Publishing House, and welcome to the Magnificent Irodori Festival, run jointly by the Yae Publishing House and the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: It's just a shame that the writer of the prize-winning text "First Apprentice of Guhua" could not release a new volume in time for the festival. I doubt we'll be able to meet them this time...

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Greetings! Welcome to Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm looking to buy some books.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Thank you for your patronage! Feel free to look around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you might be...?

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: My name is Kuroda... I'm actually the executive editor of Yae Publishing House. But the author I'm handling has yet to come up with any updates yet, so I'm pretty idle right now, so I figured, why not come down to the bookstore to help promote some books?

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Have you found anything that strikes your fancy? Feel free to let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to know about Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Yae Publishing House is founded by Lady Yae Miko, the Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. We mainly sell Light Popular Novels, which are more commonly known as Light Novels.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: As you can see, the first floor is the bookstore, where we sell the books that we have published.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: You must be an outlander, right? In that case, I highly recommend our local light novels. These are the most popular with young people nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Even some outlander authors have started to follow the trend of writing light novels now. They've even submitted some drafts to us.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Many light novel fans from other islands have traveled all the way here to buy books. They even call it a pilgrimage... Haha, well, I guess light novels are just that popular, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you! I'll have a look myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Sure. Feel free!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's the author you're in charge of...?

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh yeah, that reminds me. The author that I handle is an outlander as well. Have you ever heard of Mister Chang from Liyue? He once won an award in the "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest. "The First Apprentice of Guhua" is one of his well-known works.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: ...You say you've met this person in Liyue before? Could it be a coincidence... Anyway, I originally wanted him to come up with a cooler pseudonym, but he refused to do that and insisted on using his real name.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Still, it's thanks to him that I've got the reputation I have as an editor. I only wish that he can find his muse soon and come up with some new works.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: *sigh* If it weren't for the Sakoku Decree, I would have gone to Liyue to push... Uh, I mean, to visit him.

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh yeah, that reminds me. The author that I handle is an outlander as well. Have you ever heard of Mister Chang from Liyue? He once won an award in the "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest. "The First Apprentice of Guhua" is one of his well-known works.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: ...You say you've met this person in Liyue before? Could it be a coincidence... Anyway, I originally wanted him to come up with a cooler pseudonym, but he refused to do that and insisted on using his real name.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Still, it's thanks to him that I've got the reputation I have as an editor. I only wish that he can find his muse soon and come up with some new works.

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Well, now that the Sakoku Decree is no more, I should be able to go to Liyue and personally chas— I mean, pay him a visit!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Ah, this may be a point of reference for the novel... I'll chronicle this game right now!

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: For the work of editing King of Invokations, we must know the rules of Genius Invokation TCG by heart.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: How did this happen? Well... Fortunately, reality is not fiction, and losing a game doesn't have any real consequences...

dialogues.speaker: Kuroda
dialogues.text: Well, I won because there was actually a duel just like this one in King of Invokations...
